'''Elisa''' (Japanese: '''アキコ''' ''Akiko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG106|Beg, Burrow and Steal]]''.

Elisa is a {{tc|Pokémon Ranger}} who works and lives on [[Izabe Island]]. A lifelong friend of {{OBP|Hal|AG106}}'s, Elisa always doubted her friend's story about a secret Pokémon paradise known as the [[Trapinch underground labyrinth]] that he had seen when he was much younger.

However, after following a {{p|Trapinch}} with a tracking device on it, Elisa discovered, along with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} that Hal was indeed telling the truth. Once she saw the paradise, Elisa apologized to Hal, and both promised that they would keep the paradise safe from the likes of {{TRT}} for years to come.
